findings.desc: dev-memory-supersession-smoke covers the core projection/display happy path, but it does not cover the full CHK-001..CHK-004 must intent matrix recorded for this story. The smoke seeds one synthetic legacy/current pair where the current entry contains both tags:[supersedes-legacy1] and evidenceRefs:[dev-memory:legacy1] (packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts:51-60), so a regression in either standalone supersession mechanism would still pass even though CHK-002:happy promises both tag and evidenceRef inputs. It also does not exercise CHK-001 happy actual global/project Koala inventory across the recorded legacy ids, CHK-001 edge unmatched legacy readability, CHK-001 adversarial no rewrite/delete of historical evidenceRefs, or CHK-003 happy/edge actual superseding memories for reviewer/delivery/CLI/preflight lessons. The assertions at packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts:82-129 do cover search/preflight ordering, visible superseded/supersedes annotations, legacy readability for a matched superseded row, non_authoritative/gateEvidence=false fixture fields, and one Proofbound/Lattice mapping, but the missing cases mean the smoke is not sufficient coverage for the stated CHK-001..CHK-004 happy/edge/adversarial verification intents.
